## #0 — Being within the whole relation
A world is the articulation of Life / Mind. Its determinate things appear through constituted means to Subjective Immediacy: knower, means and known are differentiated offices of this whole. The idealist order is therefore
**Subject / Consciousness → constituted means → determinate object.**
The arrows name dependence. They do not divide reality into three substances or narrate a manufacture in which a private person first exists and subsequently invents a universe. Life / Mind names the whole; Objective Internality names its mediating office. [The shared constitution](../conjugate/AC.md) keeps those meanings distinct.
The [cultivation of an operative interior](A33-Epistemic-Cultivation-Operational-Parity.md) makes the question unavoidable. A model is encountered, its conditions can be examined, and an object can resist what was predicted of it. What is already present in this entire event? The model, the resistance and the inquiry are all disclosed within the relation of knowing. Adding another represented cause enlarges the account; it does not replace the relation through which the account exists.
## #1 — From the fact of appearing to the order of being
The [faithful definition of Subject](A01-Subject-God-and-Faithful-Definition.md) begins with a fact that its own denial enacts: appearing is. Doubt changes what is asserted within appearing; it does not place its occurrence outside it. Whatever is made available as an object is already determinate—this sensation, that body, a memory, an equation, an account of a cause. The [Subject](../concepts/C01-Subject-Defined-Indefinability.md) is the condition to which these become available, not an additional specimen among them.
Idealism carries this relation into being. A determinate thing is what it is through the distinctions and relations in which it is disclosed. Its identity, properties, differences and possible changes belong to this articulated field. The ontological claim is that such being-disclosed is constitutive of determinate being, rather than a second picture laid over a self-grounding object whose existence would already explain the whole relation. The object is a real determination of the whole; the whole is not reconstructed by accumulating its determinations.
This step is more than the observation that evidence must be encountered. It identifies the source–means–object relation as the constitution of reality's determination. A cause can explain the production of another object within that constitution. The same cause, made an object of account, cannot thereby become an exhaustive origin of the relation its own assertion requires. [The Advent of Zero](../sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-advent-zero-subject/SOURCE.md) develops this pressure through the achievement of objective exactness: making a thing available as a term brings its transformations into knowledge while leaving the act's whole condition unexhausted by that term.
The private ego belongs to the determinate side of the relation. Its memories, desires and self-image can be encountered and corrected. Substituting this formation for the Subject would turn a particular object of recognition into the supposed producer of every other centre. The ontological order instead keeps the [world-constituted interior](A26-Objective-Internality-Mind-as-Worldhood.md) open to the conditions and lives through which it exists. Another person's resistance is a real encounter, not an imperfection in my power to imagine them.
## #2 — The positive work of mediation
[Objective Internality](../concepts/C41-Objective-Internality.md) is the constituted means by which a world is discriminated, valued and acted within. Attention makes something salient; memory brings a past encounter into the present; language makes a difference available to another person; an instrument opens an event to measurement. These operations participate in what can become a determinate object. Their reality lies in their work within the act, not in their being neutral space between a finished subject and a finished object.
A paradigm gives these means a relatively durable organisation. It governs which differences matter and how an encounter can count as a reason. A project gives an achieved determination a form that can enter the world and affect further acts. [Genesis, Paradigm, Project and Epi-Logos](../etymologies/genesis-paradigm-project-epilogos/WHOLE-FIELD.md) develop their relation: the thrown-forth project can become a condition of a later project and can expose something that changes the enacted paradigm.
Resistance, persistence and shared measurement belong to this objectivity. A bridge can fail under a load whether its designer expected it to hold or not. The failure returns through observation and inquiry, changing the account of what the bridge can bear. The dependence of objectivity on the whole relation does not reduce an achieved object to whatever a particular ego currently wishes it to be. It explains why the world can correct a local organisation of its means.
The [Māyā whole](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/maya-eye-veil-frame-horizon/WHOLE.md#maya-measure-dream) gives this constituting power an interior. The eye sees a landscape through an aperture whose boundary helps determine the view. The sleeper encounters a dream with its own objects and consequences; waking alters their standing without making the encounter never have occurred. The living mirror adds recognition, recollection and response to display. These operations disclose productive mediation, not a blank veil between two independently complete things. [Diaphaneity](A04-Diaphaneity-Contextual-Transparency.md) lets the achieved view disclose something of the context through which it sees.
## #3 — Dependence has a direction and a respect
The direction of dependence must be specified. Epistemic priority concerns how knowledge becomes available. Causal priority concerns the production of a change. Logical priority concerns the premises of an account. Transcendental inquiry concerns conditions of possible experience. Ontological dependence concerns what something requires in order to be. They can cross without becoming interchangeable.
[The mirror that moves first](A32-Reflective-Field-The-Mirror-That-Moves-First.md) makes the crossing concrete. A reflection may be encountered before its source is understood. It can prompt an action and thereby change a later event. Its epistemic precedence and causal initiative are real. Yet the reflection remains dependent in being upon the relation through which it arose. The power to initiate a subsequent event does not confer the power to have originated its own source.
A represented source can itself occupy a genuine local reference office. A map can be the Bimba for a particular projection while remaining a pratibimba of wider sources. This [recursive source relation](../concepts/C61-Symbolon-Disclosure-Architecture.md) keeps the map's effective authority and its dependence together. A local source does not become unreal because it has sources; its authority becomes more exact when the relation is known.
The illegitimate reversal occurs when a projection's acquired power is used to make its own categories the sole condition under which its source may appear. The finite frame then poses as self-grounding. [Qualified predication and focal return](../concepts/C63-Pros-Hen-In-Quantum-Focal-Return-Qualified-Predication.md) require the respect in which a term is first or another depends upon it. [Homologia and analogia](../etymologies/homology-and-analogy/WHOLE-FIELD.md) similarly preserve the difference between a correspondence of operations and a claim of historical or causal descent. Distinguishing these relations makes the positive order usable; it does not leave it suspended among alternative perspectives.
## #4 — Recognition differentiates the fused account
A local self-image can appropriate the entire act: I am this body, this account, this role, this particular power. The crossed zero marks this fusion of source and means. The full recognition movement is
**`0 → Ø → X → Ø/X → (0/Ø)/(1/X) → 1 ↺ 0/1`.**
The [crossed-zero matheme](../../matheme/ql/crossed-zero-re-entry.md) develops these successive operations. `0` brackets the traversal as unobjectifiable presence. In `Ø`, the inner instrument's mark is fused with the source, and its particular activity passes as the whole I. `X` is the cut and named object-field. Apparent self and apparent world are two effects of the same determining activity. `Ø/X` makes their mediation explicit: the slash appears between the terms it had seemed merely to inhabit.
At `(0/Ø)/(1/X)`, the two recognition-relations become available together. `0/Ø` holds unoccluded presence in relation to the apparent bound self; `1/X` holds unified manifestation in relation to the discriminated field. The outer slash gathers them as a living field of availability. Recognition can occur because the whole architecture is present without any one of its states having to monopolise it.
The achieved `1` is the affirmation of Self as one being. What appeared as the bound singular `Ø` is recognised through its source; the object-field `X` is included in the integrated recognition rather than confronting it as an independent opposite. Returning as `0/1`, the source and manifestation are recognised as always already related. The passage has disclosed their pulse, not added another object to complete an inventory.
Recognition therefore changes the organisation of dependence without abolishing the productive means. A remembered injury may cease to supply the whole definition of the person to whom it happened. The memory persists; its power to organise every subsequent encounter changes. An explicit paradigm can similarly return upon an enacted one, altering the terms through which a later event will be received. The account remains a determination, but it no longer has to conceal this in order to act.

The [primordial recognition in the Neumann whole](../../mytheme/archetypal-ground/neumann-images/WHOLE.md#neumann-world-parent-separation) preserves this ordering: I-am precedes the subsequent husband/wife separation in the encountered narrative. Recognition cannot simply be assigned to the later ego's appropriation of a bounded identity. The [uroboros's opening](../../mytheme/archetypal-ground/uroboros-trickster/WHOLE.md#uroboros-interposition) gives the same return another body: the creature's completed shape retains a condition that its visible outline cannot replace.

## #5→0 — The real determination returns

The technological case enters the same order. A model can alter what happens; the means of its formation can be examined; a returned encounter can change a source, evaluator or commission. [The technological direction of dependence](../conjugate/A34-prime-Direction-of-Dependence.md) follows those changes in their actual offices. Every represented element, including a representation of the whole relay, remains determinate within the relation in which it is known and used. The power of the instrument is a real power of that relation.

[The travelling jigsaw](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/travelling-jigsaw-atlas/WHOLE.md#jigsaw-atlas-return) returns a local picture to the field through which it can travel and be corrected. [The first-moving mirror](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/mirror-that-moves-first/WHOLE.md#mirror-recursive-bimba) returns causal initiative to a source relation that initiative does not exhaust. The dream returns an experienced world to the means of its appearing; the uroboros returns the achieved whole with its opening intact. The images do different work. Each restores a relation the successful determination could obscure.

[Epi-Logos](../etymologies/genesis-paradigm-project-epilogos/WHOLE-FIELD.md#01--epi-logos--paradigmatic-reflexivity) makes the return consequential in the enacted paradigm. What is recognised can change how another person is heard, which distinction governs a judgment or what a made system is commissioned to do. The local being persists through these relations rather than disappearing into them.

[Idealism as an order of dependence](../concepts/C60-Idealism-Order-of-Dependence.md) is thus affirmative: Subjective Immediacy is the knower; Objective Internality is the constituted means; World is the known; Life / Mind is their whole. [Sensitivity to origins](A35-Compassion-Sensitivity-to-Origins-Epi-Logos-as-Vocation.md) follows from this constitution, and [Integral Zero](A36-Advent-of-Integral-Zero.md) returns it to the beginning. The determination can act without pretending to have produced the whole by which it is.
